newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek island flights hit by Olympic air dispute.
newsitem.headline: Greek island flights hit by Olympic air dispute.

text.p: Olympic Aviation, a subsidiary of Greece's state carrier Olympic Airways, which serves popular holiday islands is expected to reduce its flights for the next two weeks after a "go-slow" action by the company's mechanics.

The state-run Athens News Agency (ANA) said on Monday that at least 19 scheduled flights were cancelled and many more delayed, stranding hundreds of air travelers to the islands -- many of them foreign tourists.
Popular island destinations like Paros, Mykonos, Santorini, Skiathos, Zakynthos, Milos and Chios would be served by less than normal flights for the next two weeks.
